mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.2% signals a tightening labor market, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to impending wage inflation.
evidence_refs: fact:historical relationship between UNRATE and wage growth
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 signals increased economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window during easing cycles, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 110 and FEDFUNDS < 4.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real disposable income (RSAFS) below $360 billion signals reduced consumer spending power, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and retail sales
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS < 360000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals impending inflation, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during late-cycle expansions.
evidence_refs: fact:historical relationship between CPIAUCSL and inflation expectations
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but this effect is mitigated if FEDFUNDS is above 5%.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when PAYEMS > 150000 and FEDFUNDS < 5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3% signals a strong economy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of the monetary policy regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns when GDPC1 growth > 3% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
